summary: PASS — Classic Corgi face-transparency bug is FIXED across all four gameplay pose PNGs (corgi_jump, corgi_fall, corgi_land, corgi_hit) and the run sheet. Pixel-level scan of each PNG shows 0 or ≤6 fully-transparent pixels that heuristically satisfy the 'inside silhouette' probe test, and the residual pixels are isolated single-pixel probe-heuristic false-positives sitting in fully-transparent voids (all/most 8-neighbors are alpha=0) — none are visible face holes. Dark-checker composite renders of all 4 poses confirm every required face part is fully opaque: brown eyes on white sclera, cream-white muzzle patch, black nose, open pink tongue with white teeth, cheeks, forehead, both ears with inner-ear pink, and X-eyes on OPAQUE fur for corgi_hit. Live gameplay verification at http://localhost:3000 (mobile viewport 390x844, Classic Corgi default) confirms: fresh PLAY → running frames opaque; SPACE-triggered jump shows opaque corgi mid-rise over the tree with visible tongue and body; falling/landing frames opaque; game-over modal (REVIVE(Ad)/2x TREATS(Ad)/RESTART/MAIN MENU) renders correctly on top of a fully-opaque scene. No parallax background is visible through the corgi's face or body in any frame. No game regressions: PLAY works, HUD (BEST 0, score '0', pause, bone, TAP TO JUMP paw, TEST ADS badge) renders, gameplay parallax scrolls, fences+bones spawn, and the game-over flow triggers. Console has only permissible Vite HMR wss://localhost websocket ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED noise (expected in this preview env) and Chromium GL_CLOSE_PATH_NV WebGL driver perf warnings — NO Phaser/game runtime errors, NO missing-texture errors, NO red-screen crashes.

critical_code_review_comments: repair_classic_face.py:92-107 — the 2-pass 6-of-8-neighbors gap-close loop fires when 6/8 neighbors are alpha>200, which occasionally catches pixels just OUTSIDE the outer dark-brown outline where the outline is a thick continuous stroke (6 of the 8 neighbors are outline pixels). This is what produces the faint scattered off-white noise on the outer margin visible when composited over dark backgrounds. Consider requiring at least one of the 8 neighbors to be a 'body-fill' color (orange/cream, not outline-brown) before filling. Cosmetic only — no in-game impact.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: an earlier global near-white cleanup pass in the asset pipeline zeroed alpha for every near-white pixel — including the corgi's muzzle patch, whites of eyes, tongue highlights and paw pads — leaving see-through holes in the face+body silhouette. Fix implemented by repair_classic_face.py: for each fully-transparent pixel, run 8-direction outward probes at R=max(14, min(w,h)/40); if >=4 probes hit dark-brown outline pixels, restore alpha=255 keeping original RGB (or cream fallback if RGB was near-black). Followed by a two-pass 6-of-8-neighbors gap-close for 1-2px slivers. Verification confirms 0 visible holes remaining in the face for all 4 gameplay poses.
